title: EDP E2E Timeout and Env Contract

env_contract: APP_ENV=test is not supported by the schema
APP_ENV falls back to local when not provided

root_cause.summary: The EDP runtime test was paying a full cold bootstrap cost for each case. A module reset plus a newly created fake Prisma client forced the app graph to be reloaded too often, which pushed the first EDP case into the Vitest timeout window.
signals: The app bootstrap was being re-entered through a dynamic import path.
The fake Prisma client reference was not stable across cases.
The test setup does not define APP_ENV=test, so the env schema still resolves APP_ENV to local.

fix.summary: Create one hoisted fake Prisma client, reset its state per test, import the app through the standard createApp path, and stop resetting modules between cases.

validation.full_suite_note: The broader integration suite still depends on a reachable PostgreSQL instance from the Linux container. In this environment the external DB path was not reliable enough to treat as a pass signal for the full suite.
validation.platform: Linux Node 20 container with the worktree mounted
